description: Delete nodes (with their children and the connectors attached to them) or connectors, by id. One undo step.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

ids.description: Node or connector ids to delete (get_document lists both).

kind.description: Only match ids of this kind; any (default) matches both.

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

name: delete
title: Delete shapes
